_doc: Exact allowlist of test_drivers_import_only_driverkit.py: the sandloom.core modules each built-in driver still imports. A (file, import) pair it does not list fails, so does a stale pair (a listed import the file no longer makes, or a listed file that is gone), and a pair SEEDED in the test does not hold (a new entry) fails too. reason says why the imports stay: every row is a driver that ships in the kernel (design.md section 4, ADR-0016) and no driver package imports it.
